_doc: REPORTED published numbers (transcribed from the primary papers). Provenance labels, NOT our toy.
_source: Shannon 1948 (BSTJ 27), Shannon 1951 (BSTJ 30), Cover & King 1978, Brown et al. 1992

fn._doc: Shannon 1951 §2 — Fn n-gram entropy of printed English, bits/letter (26-letter / 27-with-space).
fn._units: F*_26 = bits per LETTER (26-letter alphabet); F*_27 = bits per SYMBOL (26 letters + space). Ratio at large n ≈ 4.5/5.5 = 0.818 — not a typo.

humanBounds._doc: Shannon 1951 §6 — human-prediction experiment, 27-symbol, with 100 letters of context.

estimates._doc: Later machine/gambling estimates of the entropy of English.

modern._doc: Bits-per-char TODAY — only on text8, which IS Shannon's 27-symbol alphabet.
modern.cite: Dai et al. 2019; Sukhbaatar et al. 2019; Radford et al. 2019; Valmeekam et al. 2023
modern._warn: enwik8/enwik9 bpc and text8 bpc are NOT the same scale (log2 206 = 7.687 vs log2 27 = 4.755). Only text8 numbers may be put beside Shannon's 4.76 / 1.0.

perplexity._doc: Perplexity anchored: WSJ n-grams (Jurafsky & Martin, Katz + Good-Turing) and LMs.
perplexity.cite: Jurafsky & Martin SLP3 §3; Radford et al. 2019; Brown et al. 2020

ru._doc: The entropy of Russian — Yaglom & Yaglom 1973 ch. IV §3 (31 letters + space = 32).
ru._warn: log2 33 = 5.044 is the MODERN 33-letter ceiling, not Yaglom's telegraph alphabet.

search._doc: The search payoff — the reported numbers behind acts 6's IDF / index / clarity slides.
search.cite: Spärck Jones 1972; Robertson 2004; Church & Gale 1995; Pibiri & Venturini 2020; Cronen-Townsend, Zhou & Croft 2002

history._doc: Key dates for the historical arc.

markov._doc: Markov's OWN 1913 counts (20 000 letters of Onegin, ъ/ь excluded) — the raw material data/l17-entropy.json markovOnegin computes on.
markov.coverage: the whole of chapter one and sixteen stanzas of chapter two

morse._doc: The Morristown type-case count and how close Morse's code lands to the optimum.
morse.cite: Gleick, The Information (2011); J. D. Cook 2017 on Norvig's frequencies; Pierce 1980
morse._warn: WHO did the counting (Morse or Vail) is disputed — Gleick: 'their partisans differ'.
